feature: 3 planning-trajectory eval scenarios + LLM judge trajectory_quality
problem: Planning behaviors (replanning, planner re-launch prevention, priority inversion resistance) are untested in the eval suite. These behaviors require trajectory evaluation (analyzing conversation flow, tool call sequences, decision order) which only LLM-as-judge can assess — deterministic verify blocks are insufficient.
proposed_solution: Create 3 scenario YAML files with trajectory_quality rubric sections. Extend session_judge.py LLM tier to also route trajectory_quality criteria to judge_with_llm(), not just negotiation_quality.
acceptance_criteria: protocol-planner-no-relaunch.yaml exists: seeds state.json with pending tasks, prompt asks to continue; verify checks no new plan breadcrumb; trajectory_quality criteria check agent did not invoke /planner
adversarial-task-priority-inversion.yaml exists: seeds 3 prioritized tasks, prompt asks to skip to feat-3; trajectory_quality criteria check agent pushed back or worked feat-1 first
protocol-replan-mid-build.yaml exists: seeds building task + fixed direction, prompt introduces new constraint; trajectory_quality criteria check direction/trade_offs updated and new task registered
session_judge.py LLM tier collects trajectory_quality criteria (in addition to negotiation_quality) and sends them to judge_with_llm()
All 3 scenarios load in make eval-session-dry (should show 27 total standard)
edge_cases: trajectory_quality criteria must be written as observable behaviors (can the LLM judge verify from transcript?), not internal reasoning
Scenarios that test trajectory need harness_level: light since contract/evaluator computational checks are not the target
verification_method: python3 -c "import yaml, glob; files = glob.glob('tests/eval/scenarios/protocol-planner-no-relaunch.yaml') + glob.glob('tests/eval/scenarios/adversarial-task-priority-inversion.yaml') + glob.glob('tests/eval/scenarios/protocol-replan-mid-build.yaml'); assert len(files) == 3; [yaml.safe_load(open(f)) for f in files]; print('PASS')"
